description: Compute the pie-menu for a target object or Sim from your perspective. Prerequisite: you are in a lot with a live local VM (d87-a) and the target is present in that VM (visible in perception.nearby_objects or .nearby_sims). No outbound PDU — this is a local-VM query using VMEntity.GetPieMenu (the same call the perception emitter already exercises at 2048 pie-menus/64 ticks, freesoexperiment-66c); the result is what the UI pie-menu would show if you clicked that target. Effect: returns the list of interactions the engine will accept for interact-with / queue-interaction on this target; each entry carries the TTAB id, display name, param0 variant, and whether it comes from the callee's GLOBAL TTAB (rare). Cost: one tick-lock acquisition — the computation reads TTAB data and runs CheckAction scripts that the tick thread also mutates, so it is serialized with the tick. Keep queries sparse; for continuous surveillance use the perception stream instead.

args.name: target_object_id
args.description: ObjectID of the target (short). Required if target_sim_id is not set.

args.name: target_sim_id
args.description: PersistID of an avatar (uint). Resolves to that avatar's ObjectID in the local VM. Required if target_object_id is not set.

args.name: include_hidden
args.description: Include interactions flagged HideInteraction/Hidden (normally suppressed from the UI).

args.name: include_global
args.description: Include interactions from the GLOBAL TTAB (applied to every object). Default true — matches stock client behaviour.
